## How to Sign

When you open a Pull Request for the first time, the **CLA Assistant bot**
will comment on your PR with a link to sign electronically. Signing takes
under one minute and is required only once — all future PRs from your account
are automatically recognized.

If you have questions about this CLA, open a GitHub Discussion or contact the
maintainers directly.
